description.value: This independently owned Subway franchise in Burnaby's Royal Oak neighbourhood offers freshly made sandwiches, wraps, salads, and breakfast items to order. The location supports in-restaurant dining, curbside pickup, and delivery, making it a convenient stop for a quick customizable meal. It accepts multiple payment methods including cash, and is part of the Subway Rewards loyalty program.
